reason: I closely compare cost per gram on all grocery items, and paying ₹99 for 100g is completely disproportionate when trusted shelf sauces cost ₹14 to ₹35 per 100g. Plus, having to place a separate online order and wait days for a tube that might just squirt separated water isn't worth it.
objection: Extremely steep unit cost of nearly ₹1 per gram combined with the risk of messy watery emulsion separation.
would_change_my_mind: Selling a family size on quick commerce apps at a unit rate comparable to standard sauces, under ₹60 for 100g.
